name: Dual M -Sora no Kioku-
original_name: デュアル・エム ―空の記憶―
source:
Mika and Loki run a VA detective agency at Chesterland School, the Japanese branch of a British school for foreigners. Of course since they’re amateurs, they don’t get many cases. However, Mika is a psychometrist, able to understand the past of someone or something just by touching them. It comes at a price though. If used on a human, the target will lose all their memories related to him. Due to a past incident, his mother has lost all memories of him and so he now always wears a glove on his hand. One day, Loki read about a story about the murder of the owner of the club Couples Apples in the newspaper and wanted Mika to try to solve the case, but he is hesitant since he doesn’t want to use his power. Then, he was approached by two girls who say they are being threatened and want him to stop the culprit.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/06/01/june-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
美香与洛基在英国外侨学校日本分校Chesterland学园经营一家VA侦探事务所。当然，由于两人只是业余侦探，几乎接不到什么案件。不过，美香拥有接触感应能力，只要触碰某人或某物，就能了解其过去；这种力量也伴随着代价。如果对人使用，对方将失去所有与他有关的记忆。过去的一起事件令母亲忘记了关于他的一切，因此他如今总在手上戴着手套。一天，洛基从报纸上读到Couples Apples俱乐部老板遭谋杀的新闻，希望美香尝试破案，但美香不愿使用自己的能力，因而犹豫不决。随后，两名女孩找到他，声称自己正在遭受威胁，希望他制止犯人。

[摘自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/06/01/june-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
